'''Premiere &ndash; Reflections II''' (display name '''Premiere - Reflections II''') is a constructed environment whose legal pool is the printed Decipher sets from [[Premiere]] through [[Reflections II]].

The [[2021 Worlds Throwback Event]] (Prem-RefII) was played in this format.<ref name="pcrefii">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2021-worlds-retro-prem-ref-ii-event/ 2021 Worlds Retro (Prem-Ref II) Event], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013162117/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2021-worlds-retro-prem-ref-ii-event.html Internet Archive].</ref> It is a narrower printed pool than [[Premiere - Theed Palace]] (Premiere through Theed Palace, GEMP Decipher Cards Only). It also differs from [[Premiere - Reflections III]], the pool of the [[2001 Decipher World Championship]].

|}
